name: Ombre d'un autre monde

location.subLocation: Région de la Cour de Fontaine

description: The behemoth that once devoured the birthing waters of the planet has departed without a single trace, but those in the know will forever live, surely, in the terrifying shadow of that omen of the end. A single shard of shattered spacetime remains in this place, and through it, you may perhaps be able to witness that titanic creature once more.
